correctness.rationale: For the height-one 2m-vertex crown with 2m edges, twisted degree-one cocycles correspond to edges allowed by the dihedral symmetry, and degree-zero cochains to its fixed vertices. For identity, connected weighted-cycle incidence rank is 2m-1 iff holonomy=1, else 2m, giving dimensions 1/0. Nonidentity rotations have no fixed vertices; ±1 rotations allow m edges, other shifts zero. Each reflection allows four edges and two disjoint nonzero fixed-vertex coboundaries, giving dimension 2 in all characteristics. Unit groups modulo central scalars and multiplicative holonomy classes yield |Aut A|=2m q^(2m)(q-1)^(2m). Classes then give Pr[m]=1/m, Pr[2]=1/2, Pr[1]=1/(2m(q-1)), residual Pr[0], and E[d]=2+1/(2m(q-1)) while weak limit has mean 1. Independent weighted cochain ranks verified through m=12 over p=2,3,5 (873 cumulative crown assertions); source independently provides defining skew-Leibniz checker. The all-m proof is structural, not finite extrapolation.
